messages:
Riley Brooks: quick flag  30 leads stuck in enrichment >10m, dashboard spike on HS->SF SLA.
Samira Khan: thanks Riley. source?
Riley Brooks: mostly webinar signups + a handful from paid ads. enrichment vendor timing out.
Diego Alvarez: proposed quick fix: if enrichment >8s, tag lead `enrich:fast_fallback` and run HS workflow to assign to `Inbound - Triage` via round-robin. Keep cooldown 20m for triage pool.
Samira Khan: +1. add a rate cap: max 20 auto-assigns/min to avoid flooding SDRs. HubSpotBot: workflow created: "Fallback: enrich timeout" (id: wf_4592)
Riley Brooks: Diego, can you emit metric `enrich.fallback.count` so Pulse can alert if >50 in 5m?
Diego Alvarez: yep will emit counter and a timer `enrich.latency_ms`. Pushing a tiny patch now.
Samira Khan: I'll update the HS workflow to check `enrich:fast_fallback` and `recent_auto_assigns_5m < 20` before assigning. Also set triage cooldown to 20m.
Riley Brooks: rolling this to 5% canary first. If SLA improves, we'll ramp.
Samira Khan: created canary list and toggled workflow for 5% - monitoring channel #marketing-sla for updates.
Diego Alvarez: patch merged behind flag `enrich_fallback_canary`. smoke test passed.
Riley Brooks: thanks team  we'll regroup in 24h unless alerts fire. :thumbsup:
